summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with an acute exacerbation of chronic abdominal pain and diarrhea, consistent with her prior episodes. She was treated with rifaximin and hyoscyamine, with significant improvement in symptoms. Workup showed no infectious cause, supporting a diagnosis of small intestinal bacterial overgrowth. Hypogammaglobulinemia was confirmed with a low IgG level, and she received IVIG to support immune function. Her nausea and vomiting resolved, and she tolerated oral intake well. She was transitioned to Augmentin for continued treatment of bacterial overgrowth and discharged home with follow-up appointments in GI and hematology. Her chronic graft-versus-host disease was managed with ongoing prednisone and new autologous eye drops for ocular symptoms.
problems: Chronic myeloid leukemia, without mention of having achieved remission
